method: Preserve three separate creator or channel-account samples and each vendor's observation-window behavior. For company sites use separately linked public channels; for brand indexed creators use 2025 vendor coverage; for below-1000 subscriber channels use vidIQ public net video count changes, explicitly not inactivity.
population: Indexed 10k+ channel accounts, website-linked company channels with a published video, and below-1000 tracked accounts with 360-day endpoint visibility; no representative all-creator inception cohort

limitations: The publisher does not supply full verified sample-selection mechanics or a calendar-day end for the previous-30-day window.
Dormant in a 30-day activity measure is not irreversible abandonment or account closure.
Established 10k+ channel accounts exclude many smaller or new channels, and distinct account ownership is not verified.
Company website inclusion and link discovery are not a randomized creator sample; website inaccessibility and unpublished channel links are selection filters.
No public upload for 90 days or one year does not show company closure, creator career end, or zero past revenue.
The company-channel sample is not a matched subset of Click Analytic's established influencer index.
Zero net count can conceal uploads offset by deletions, private/visibility changes or reprocessing.
Channels with negative net video count changes, missing history, and zero public baseline videos were excluded.
Subscriber gate attainment is not channel activity, continued earning, retirement or first-year entrant survivorship.

safe_reading: Do not combine 57% vendor-defined nonactivity over 30 days, 46% company-channel upload silence over 90 days, or zero public-video-count change in a selected 360-day cohort into one attrition percentage.
required_future_measurements: Defined first-publication or independently verified channel start date and selection frame
Repeated dated actual upload events with deletions/visibility changes resolved
Channel/platform suspension versus voluntary stop versus a long creative pause
Nonresponse, missing-history, removed channel and right-censoring records
Owner-consented receipts and unpaid work by entrant cohort, including never-monetizing channels
Matched niche/geography cohort before new-versus-mature attrition comparisons
